question: Do EU and UK private-label buyers (retailers and their importers) source plant-based foods from Asian co-packers, and at what price per kg and protein level would they list a Vietnamese product?
why_it_matters: Private label is where price-led European demand is resilient and where Vietnam's 9 to 13 point EVFTA and UKVFTA tariff edge matters most; we found no revealed case of Western plant-based production in Vietnam.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ten structured buyer interviews at Anuga or SIAL plus a request for quotation test with two co-packers
owner_org_to_ask: GFI Europe; EuroCham Vietnam food and beverage sector committee; Vietnam Trade Office in the EU

question: Do plant-based foods made in Vietnam from imported (Chinese or US) soy protein or wheat gluten meet EVFTA, UKVFTA and CPTPP rules of origin for chapter 21 and 19 products?
why_it_matters: If the imported protein input breaks origin, the tariff edge disappears for exactly the products Vietnam can make today.
cheapest_way_to_close: Desk check of EVFTA Protocol 1 product-specific rules for 2106 and 1902, confirmed with a binding origin ruling request
owner_org_to_ask: Ministry of Industry and Trade (origin department); VCCI certificate of origin office

question: Which Japanese and Korean food manufacturers would buy Vietnamese functional plant or fungal proteins for hybrid or processed meat, and to what specification?
why_it_matters: Japan imports about USD 149 million of plant protein ingredients and admits Vietnamese textured vegetable protein duty-free; this is the most plausible B2B export entry.
cheapest_way_to_close: JETRO and KOTRA matchmaking; sample submissions to three Japanese processed-meat makers
owner_org_to_ask: JETRO Ho Chi Minh City; KOTRA Hanoi; Japan Plant Based Food Association

question: Do ASC-certified feed mills in Vietnam face buyer requests to cut soy or fishmeal or to report feed carbon footprints, and what price premium, if any, would they pay for a domestic non-soy protein?
why_it_matters: This is the most frontier-relevant export-linked demand signal; no retrieved source quantifies it.
cheapest_way_to_close: Short survey of the 20 ASC-programme feed mills and the top 10 shrimp and pangasius exporters

question: What does ASC Feed Standard v1.2 (mandatory since 2 February 2026) change against v1.1, and when must ASC farms use ASC-certified feed?
why_it_matters: We read v1.1 only; farm-level feed deadlines decide how fast the feed pull reaches Vietnamese mills.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read v1.2 and the ASC Farm Standard feed requirements on the ASC programme centre

question: What volume and value of vegetarian and vegan products does Vietnam export (Au Lac, An Nhien, SG Food, Agrex Saigon, Emmay), and to which importers?
why_it_matters: Company export claims are unverified; revealed diaspora trade is visible only on shelves.
cheapest_way_to_close: Customs declaration-level data (8-digit HS 2106.90, 1902, 2103) by exporter, or US import bill-of-lading data
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam Customs (General Department); commercial bill-of-lading databases

question: Is there a Vietnamese vegan fish sauce or plant-based seafood export, and who buys it?
why_it_matters: The brief listed these as possible platforms; we found no evidence either way beyond general sauce exports (HS 2103.90).
cheapest_way_to_close: Check Weee!, H Mart and Asian grocers in Europe for listings; ask Cholimex and Masan
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnamese sauce makers; Asian grocers in the US and EU

question: What are 2023 to 2026 revealed plant-based sales in China, Singapore, Australia and the Gulf states?
why_it_matters: We could not retrieve revealed data for these destinations, so their demand direction is unknown.
cheapest_way_to_close: Euromonitor or NielsenIQ extracts via GFI APAC; Food Frontier reports for Australia

question: Is Vietnam's national halal certification recognised in GCC states and Malaysia, and is there demand for halal plant-based meat there?
why_it_matters: Vietnam already ships cashew and coconut to Muslim-majority markets; halal plant-based could be an entry product.
cheapest_way_to_close: Desk review of HALCERT recognition lists and GCC import rules; interviews with two UAE importers
owner_org_to_ask: National Halal Certification Centre (HALCERT); Vietnam Trade Office in the UAE

question: What preferential tariffs do Korea (VKFTA, RCEP) and China (ACFTA, RCEP) apply to Vietnamese 2106.10, 2106.90 and 2202.99?
why_it_matters: Korea and China are large buyers of Vietnamese food; the tariff position of plant-based lines was not checked.
cheapest_way_to_close: Look up KCS and China customs tariff tables for the three lines
owner_org_to_ask: Korea Customs Service; General Administration of Customs of China; MOIT

question: What is the composition of Vietnam's HS 3504 exports (USD 13 million in 2023): fish collagen peptides or other proteins?
why_it_matters: If it is marine collagen, it is the existing template for B2B protein ingredient exports to Europe.
cheapest_way_to_close: 8-digit customs data or Vinh Hoan (Vinh Wellness) annual report

question: Are textured soy protein (2106.10) and soy-based food preparations outside EUDR Annex I?
why_it_matters: Determines whether Vietnamese exporters of soy-based foods must run EUDR due diligence from 30 December 2026.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 as amended and the Commission FAQ
owner_org_to_ask: European Commission DG Environment; EU Delegation to Vietnam

question: How much would the US Section 301 rate of 12.5% on Vietnam change under any US-Vietnam trade arrangement in 2026 to 2027?
why_it_matters: A move to 10% or below would reopen the US for Vietnamese plant-based convenience foods relative to Malaysia, Indonesia and India.
cheapest_way_to_close: Monitor USTR Federal Register notices and Vietnam MOIT statements
owner_org_to_ask: USTR; Ministry of Industry and Trade

question: Which EU language versions allow 'coconut milk' and similar traditional names under the dairy-term exception list?
why_it_matters: Coconut-based dairy alternatives are a Vietnamese strength; label rules differ by term and language.
